My code as below:

server.R

load('./data/names.Rdata')

shinyServer(function(input, output) {
  
  output$result_table <- renderTable({ 
    subset(names, sex == input$select_gender & year >= input$year_range[1] & year <= input$year_range[2] )
  })
})

ui.R

titlePanel("Name Data"),
  
  sidebarLayout(
    sidebarPanel("User inputs will be here",
                 selectInput("gender","Gender",c(
                   "Male"="1" ,
                   "Female"= "2")),
                   
                 sliderInput("year_range", 
                             label = "Range of years:",
                             min = 1952, max = 2007, 
                             value = c(1955, 2005),
                             format = "####")
    ),
    mainPanel("My cool graph will go here",
              tableOutput("result_table")              
    )
  )
))


Table with variables names shows but empty.
I have column sex coded as 1 for Male and 2 for Female. What is wrong??

Regards

I don't know what your data looks like, but the first thing I'd do is to not use the subset() function, and use [-style subsetting instead. From the subset help page:

This is a convenience function intended for use interactively. For programming it is better to use the standard subsetting functions like [, and in particular the non-standard evaluation of argument subset can have unanticipated consequences.
